Amid widespread rumors on social media about his death, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu released a video from a café to show that he is alive. 

The Prime Minister’s office also dismissed the assassination claims, confirming that the reports are false

(Video: Benjamin Netanyahu/X) | WION | Facebook
